verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for https://rocm.docs.amd.com/llms.txt, a ROCm documentation index that also points to per-project llms.txt files, so an agent can be pointed at it for the MI355X software stack. Other agent-oriented formats are thin: the per-page markdown probe (.md) returned 404, and the probe shows only a truncated snippet of the file. missing for 10: markdown/plain-text page variants for agents, evidence of llms.txt coverage depth across Instinct-specific docs (instinct.docs.amd.com), independent corroboration of agent use.
